stem.text: A tube of length $L$ is open at both ends. A stationary wave is set up in this tube when a tuning fork vibrating with frequency $f_x$ is held at one end. This is the lowest frequency of stationary wave that can be formed in this tube.

Another tube of length $2L$ is closed at one end. A stationary wave is set up in this tube when a tuning fork vibrating with frequency $f_y$ is held at the open end. This is the lowest frequency of stationary wave that can be formed in this tube.

stem.alt: Open tube of length L with a dimension arrow labelled L, and a tuning fork at one end labelled frequency f_x.
Tube closed at one end with a dimension arrow labelled 2L, and a tuning fork at the open end labelled frequency f_y.

stem.text: Assume the end correction for each tube is negligible.
